definitions.explanation: Describes doing something with great thoroughness and intensity, leaving no gaps or shortcuts. Commonly used for training, studying, or working.
Describes something being filled to capacity with no space left.

examples.japanese: みっちり⟦{練習|れんしゅう}する→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧。
⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧みっちり⟦{鍛|きた}えられた→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧。
examples.english: I was rigorously trained by my teacher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧みっちり⟦{特訓|とっくん}→特訓：13466_tokkun⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{本番|ほんばん}→本番：19392_honban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えた→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧。
examples.english: I trained intensively for a week before the match to prepare for the real thing.

examples.japanese: ⟦スケジュール→スケジュール：03850_sukejuuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧みっちり⟦{詰|つ}まっている→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧。
⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧みっちり⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The box is crammed full of things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{晩|ばん}→晩：00542_ban⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧みっちり⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っていて→入る：00494_hairu⟧、⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: From morning to night my schedule is packed solid, and I have no time to rest.

notes:
A mimetic adverb with two related senses: thorough intensity (for activities) and tight packing (for spaces/schedules). The common thread is the idea of leaving no gaps.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- みっちり⟦{練習|れんしゅう}する→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧: to practice intensively
- みっちり⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧: to train rigorously
- みっちり⟦{勉強|べんきょう}する→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧: to study thoroughly
- みっちり⟦{詰|つ}まっている→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧: to be packed tight
- みっちり⟦{仕込|しこ}む→仕込む：04244_shikomu⟧: to train someone thoroughly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧: properly, thoroughly — broader usage, emphasizes doing things right
- ⟦びっしり→びっしり：05892_bisshiri⟧: densely packed, filled with — emphasizes visual density (text, schedules)
- ⟦ぎっしり→ぎっしり：05891_gisshiri⟧: jam-packed — emphasizes physical tightness of packing
- ⟦{徹底的|てっていてき}→徹底的：06827_tetteiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: thoroughly — more formal equivalent for the "intensive" sense

REGISTER:
Informal but not overly casual. Common in everyday conversation, especially about training, studying, or busy schedules.
